Roommate Wanted – 4BD/4.5BA Townhome in Mid-City (July 1 Move-In)

Hi ladies! 💛

We’re looking for a roommate to fill the 4th bedroom in our beautiful 4bd/4.5ba Mid-City townhome. Our current roommate will not be renewing at the end of our lease (June 30), and we’re hoping to find someone to join us starting July 1st for a 1-year commitment .

✨ The Space:
Private bedroom with en-suite bathroom (shower/tub)
Walk-in closet in every room
Open-concept kitchen with lots of cabinet space
Spacious shared living area + half-bath on main floor
Balcony for fresh air and chill time

💸 Rent & Utilities:
Rent (includes parking): $1150/month
LADWP (fixed plan): ~ $95month per person
WiFi (Spectrum): ~$18/month per person
SoCal Gas ~ $8/month per person 
Parking: includes 1 tandem spot (garage + tandem setup, total of 4 spots)

🏡 About Us: We are all women of color and would love to welcome another POC woman into our home🤎

Kiara – (26) is a part time retail associate and full-time film student. She spends most of her time working on indie films and coordinating film events via @filmsforsundays. She enjoys wine nights, thrifting, and trying new places to eat (especially in ktown).

Semoné – (30) is a full time worker and Clinical psychology graduate student. She enjoys trying new restaurants & cafes, karaoke, going on long walks/hikes, and thrifting. 

Sìmone (29) – I work as a server at a hotel restaurant in West Hollywood and am also an actress, dancer, and journalist. I love hot yoga, hiking, movies, and trying new restaurants/coffee shops with friends.

We all have different schedules and do our own thing day-to-day, but we enjoy occasional roomie nights / girls nights when we can ✨

📍 Location Perks: Centrally located in Mid-City with easy access to:
Koreatown
Culver City
DTLA
Beverly Hills
West Hollywood
Not far from LAX + the beach 🌊

🐾 Pets: We don’t currently have pets, but we’re open to discussing if you have a small furry friend!

We’ve truly loved living here for the last year and are excited to find someone who’s a great fit for our home and energy 💫

If you’re interested, send us a message with a little about yourself and if you’re a good fit, we can schedule a showing of the apartment! 

Semone Watson
